summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Fortuna Mining Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, announcing positive feasibility study results for its Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal. The filing describes an after-tax IRR of 60% and NPV of $1 billion at $3,500/oz gold, with a 9.4-year mine life and average annual production of 116,000 ounces. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is disclosed; this is a routine operational update and project development report. Therefore, it does not qualify as a special situation.
